identity.name: Archax Ltd (FCA-regulated) - beneficial ownership of State Street USD Liquidity LVNAV Fund units

about.registryInfo: Beneficial-ownership token issued by Archax Ltd (FCA-regulated digital securities exchange, brokerage and custodian): Archax purchases units of the underlying institutional money market fund via its nominee and issues tokens 1:1 against custodied fund units on Hedera (KYC key set; whitelist-gated transfers), with small XDC side deployments. Only onboarded professional Archax clients can hold or transfer.
